title: If the Boston Celtics agree to trade Jaylen Brown by July 31, 2026, which NBA team will be his destination?
background: Jaylen Brown plays for the Boston Celtics and was named the 2024 NBA Finals MVP.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reporting by ESPN or The Associated Press identifying an agreed trade involving Jaylen Brown between June 1 and July 31, 2026.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the team designated to receive Brown under the first such publicly reported agreement. An agreement counts even if league approval or completion remains pending.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the NBA team.

title: Which U.S. state will have the highest reported cyclospora case count by July 16, 2026?
background: Cyclospora is a parasite that causes intestinal illness. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) monitors reported infections across U.S. states.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The latest CDC state-level data publicly available on July 16, 2026, reporting the cumulative number of cyclospora infections reported during 2026
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-16
  • Accepted Answer Format: String (name of the U.S. state)

title: With which country will the United States record its largest trade deficit in May 2026?
background: The United States publishes monthly trade data, including trade balances with its major trading partners.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve using the country-level trade balances in the initial May 2026 trade report from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau. Identify the individual country associated with the largest U.S. trade deficit, excluding regional groupings.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-07
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.

title: Which Chinese province will evacuate the most people in preparation for Typhoon Bavi by July 11, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Chinese authorities' figures in contemporaneous news coverage. Resolve to the Chinese province with the largest reported number of people evacuated in preparation for Typhoon Bavi as of July 11, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-11
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the province's name.

title: If Bavi makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, which province will it strike first?
background: Landfall occurs when a tropical cyclone's center crosses the coastline. This question concerns only mainland China.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official landfall reports from China’s National Meteorological Center, supplemented by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the province containing the location of Bavi’s first mainland-China landfall during July 2026. Subsequent landfalls do not count. If no qualifying landfall occurs during that month, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the province.

title: Which Gaza locality will be the site of the deadliest Israeli strike reported on July 17, 2026?
background: A ceasefire between Israel and Hamas took effect in October 2025, but Israeli attacks in Gaza have continued.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Al Jazeera's July 17, 2026 reporting on that day's attacks across Gaza. Compare individual strikes rather than cumulative deaths across separate attacks.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Resolve to the city, town, or refugee camp where the individual Israeli strike with the highest reported death toll occurred. Answer with the locality's name.

title: Who will win the middleweight main event at UFC Fight Night in Oklahoma City on July 18, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official UFC results or contemporaneous reporting from reputable news organizations.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of the event’s middleweight main event on fight night, excluding any subsequent changes to the result.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning fighter’s full name.

title: Who will be appointed head of Syria’s National Security Bureau in July 2026?
background: The National Security Bureau oversees Syria’s security agencies.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official Syrian government announcement or reporting by the Syrian state news agency SANA identifying the person appointed head of the National Security Bureau during July 2026.
  • Resolution Date: The date the appointment is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointee’s full name.

title: Who will succeed Oleksandr Syrskii as Ukraine's top military commander?
background: Oleksandr Syrskii leads Ukraine's armed forces during the war against Russia.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by Ukraine's presidency or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve when Ukraine's president formally appoints a successor to Oleksandr Syrskii as the country's top military commander. Temporary or acting appointments do not count unless confirmed as permanent.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The successor's full name.

title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The province's name.

title: Which Indian state will have the highest reported death toll from monsoon floods and landslides as of August 5, 2026?
background: India's annual monsoon can cause fatal floods and landslides across multiple states.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the Indian state with the highest reported cumulative death toll from monsoon floods and landslides since July 1, 2026, according to official data cited in news reporting
  • Resolution Date: August 5, 2026
  • Accepted Answer Format: The state's name

title: Who will be appointed Peru's foreign minister in the incoming presidential administration's first cabinet in July 2026?
background: A new presidential administration is scheduled to take office in Peru in July 2026. Its foreign minister will oversee the country's diplomatic relations.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Peruvian government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the person officially appointed minister of foreign affairs in the incoming administration's first cabinet, with the appointment announced by July 31, 2026. Speculation about potential appointments does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed foreign minister's full name.

title: Who will succeed Brendon McCullum as permanent head coach of England's men's Test team?
background: Brendon McCullum currently coaches England's men's Test cricket team.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official England and Wales Cricket Board appointment announcement or reliable contemporaneous reporting of that announcement.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the first person formally appointed as McCullum's permanent successor as head coach of England's men's Test team. Interim appointments and appointments solely concerning limited-overs cricket do not count. Resolution occurs when the appointment is announced, even if the coach begins work later.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed coach's full name.

title: Which international organization, if any, will first gain direct access to Aung San Suu Kyi in detention during 2026?
background: Aung San Suu Kyi has been detained since Myanmar's military overthrew her government in February 2021. Her access to outside visitors has been tightly restricted.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements from the visiting organization or Myanmar authorities, corroborated by established news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Direct access means a completed in-person meeting with Suu Kyi by a representative acting on behalf of an international organization. Permission or an announced plan without a completed visit does not qualify.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the first international organization publicly confirmed to have completed such a visit during 2026. If no qualifying visit is confirmed by December 31, 2026, resolve that no organization qualified.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The organization's name, or a statement that no organization qualified.

title: Which university will house Raja Shehadeh's personal diary archive by August 31, 2026?
background: Raja Shehadeh is a Palestinian writer and lawyer who has kept personal diaries since 1967.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the university confirmed to be physically holding Shehadeh's original personal diary archive by August 31, 2026. Confirmation must come from public statements by Shehadeh or the receiving university, or contemporaneous news reporting establishing that the archive has arrived, rather than merely announcing a planned transfer.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-31
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (institution). Answer with the university's name.

title: Which prominent RSF field commander will Darfur's governor announce has been killed in western Sudan in early August 2026?
background: The Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are a paramilitary group fighting Sudan's army in a war that began in April 2023.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the RSF field commander whose death in fighting in western Sudan Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi announces during August 1–10, 2026, according to Al Jazeera's reporting. The question concerns the governor's announcement, not independent confirmation of the death.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-10 (announcement window: August 1–10, 2026)
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the commander's name, omitting military rank and nickname.

title: What sentence will Egyptian television presenter Sarah Khalifa receive at trial in her drug-trafficking case?
background: Sarah Khalifa was arrested in Egypt in April 2025 as part of a drug investigation.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The trial court’s announced judgment in the drug-trafficking prosecution stemming from Khalifa’s April 2025 arrest, as confirmed by official court information or reliable reporting from Al-Ahram.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the trial court announces its verdict and sentence. Later appellate decisions and judgments in unrelated cases do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide a short legal term identifying the principal penalty imposed, or the court’s disposition if no penalty is imposed. If multiple penalties are imposed, report the most severe.

title: Which country will host Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit as Myanmar's military chief?
background: Ye Win Oo assumed Myanmar's military leadership in April 2026 after Min Aung Hlaing became president.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official statements from the governments involved or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations identifying the destination of Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit after assuming military leadership in April 2026.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve once the visit has begun and is publicly confirmed, rather than when travel plans are merely announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The destination country's common English name.

title: What source of cocaine exposure will UK Anti-Doping cite when publicly explaining the resolution of Joseph Parker's October 2025 doping case?
background: Joseph Parker is a former world heavyweight boxing champion from New Zealand. He tested positive for cocaine in connection with his October 2025 fight against Fabio Wardley and has denied knowingly taking banned substances.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UK Anti-Doping's official decision or public statement explaining the resolution of Parker's case arising from the cocaine tests associated with his October 2025 bout.
  • Resolution: Resolve when UK Anti-Doping publicly identifies the source of Parker's cocaine exposure in its explanation of the case's resolution. Use the source identified by the agency.
  • Accepted Answer Format: A concise noun phrase identifying the stated source of exposure.

title: Which districts will hold polling on August 10 in Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election?
background: Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election is scheduled to take place in three phases.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official election-authority records or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the districts where polling takes place on August 10, 2026.
  • Resolution: The answer will be the complete set of districts within Pakistan-administered Kashmir where Legislative Assembly polling opens on that date.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The district names, joined by “and”.

title: Which major US employment sector will shed the most jobs in July 2026?
background: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reports monthly changes in nonfarm payroll employment by sector.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the broad employment sector with the largest net decline in payroll jobs in July 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics' initial employment report for that month, released in August 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-07
  • Accepted Answer Format: Compare sectors by the number of jobs lost, not percentage changes, and count subsectors within their parent sectors. Answer with the sector's name.

title: From which UK city will the aid boat Kate depart on its Gaza mission in August 2026?
background: The Freedom Flotilla organizes sea voyages aimed at delivering aid to Gaza and challenging Israel's blockade.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the UK city from which Kate sets sail in August 2026 as part of a Freedom Flotilla effort to reach Gaza, according to contemporaneous reporting of its departure.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-16
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the city name.

title: Which city will be the site of Typhoon Dolphin's first landfall in mainland China in August 2026?
background: Dolphin developed into a typhoon over the Pacific in late July 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Landfall information issued by China's meteorological authorities, either directly or through contemporaneous reliable news coverage.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the city identified as the location of Dolphin's first mainland China landfall during August 2026. Offshore island landfalls do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the city name, rather than its province or a broader geographical region.

title: Which Israeli company will Save the Children Norway urge Norway's sovereign wealth fund to divest from by September 20, 2026?
background: Norway's sovereign wealth fund reduced its holdings in Israeli companies in 2025, citing the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the Israeli company publicly identified by Save the Children Norway or its representatives as a divestment target over concerns that its products could contribute to violations of international humanitarian law. Use statements or contemporaneous reporting published between January 1 and September 20, 2026. Answer with the company's full name.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-20
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (company)

title: Who will score Bangladesh's first men's Test century on Australian soil?
background: A Test century is an individual score of at least 100 runs in a single innings. No Bangladesh batter has yet achieved this milestone in a men's Test played in Australia.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Test match scorecards and contemporaneous reputable cricket reporting confirming the first such century.
  • Resolution Condition: The question resolves when a player representing Bangladesh first reaches 100 runs in a single innings of an official men's Test match played in Australia.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The batter's full name.

title: Which Indonesian province will be struck by the country's deadliest earthquake between January 1 and August 17, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the province identified as the location of Indonesia's deadliest earthquake occurring from January 1 through August 17, 2026. Determine the deadliest earthquake using fatalities reported by Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency as of August 17, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the province's name.

title: Which club will win the 2026 FA Community Shield?
background: The FA Community Shield is English football's traditional curtain-raiser ahead of the domestic league season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Football Association's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the result.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the club that wins the 2026 FA Community Shield, including a victory by penalty shootout if applicable.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name.

title: Which broad demand component will contribute most to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth in April–June 2026?
background: Japan's Cabinet Office publishes quarterly GDP estimates, including a breakdown of demand components' contributions to growth.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Cabinet Office's August 2026 release of Japan's April–June 2026 GDP estimates. Use that release's figures rather than subsequent revisions.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Resolve to the top-level demand component with the largest percentage-point contribution to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth for April–June 2026. Answer with the component's standard name.

title: To which hospital will Pakistan’s Supreme Court order Imran Khan transferred for medical care in August 2026?
background: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan is imprisoned at Adiala jail. His eye condition has required specialist treatment, and concerns about his health have been central to his party’s campaign for his release.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Supreme Court’s order or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations describing its requirements.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the hospital designated in the Supreme Court’s next order, issued after the start date and during August 2026, directing Khan’s transfer from Adiala jail for hospital care.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the hospital.
